subject: pe
title: Moments and Joint Loading
welcome_lead: Calculate the turning forces that load knees, hips and elbows.
meta_desc: A-Level PE adventure on moments of force and joint stress.
final_note: Reduce the lever arm or distribute the load — biomechanics prevents injury.

concepts.def: Force × perpendicular distance from fulcrum (N m).

walkthroughs.body_html: A biceps curl with 20 N load at 30 cm needs muscle force F at 5 cm: F = 20×0.30/0.05 = 120 N.
Joint reaction includes muscle force plus external load — quadriceps force during squat may exceed body weight 5×.
Shorter lever arms (deeper squat depth) shift moments, redistributing knee/hip loading.
